output.reason: The release note [ev-1cabcddbde95] and the PR description [ev-70e6039a6833] say only that a new v1alpha1 Operation controller is implemented. Neither names the API group. The PR's changed files [ev-84a5ffab410d] put the type under a new apis/ops/v1alpha1 package, separate from apis/apiextensions and apis/pkg. That points to an ops-specific group rather than the bare "crossplane.io" in the proposal, but no excerpt states the group, so the proposed gvk-in-use leaf is unsupported. This is also a purely additive, opt-in API: the upgrade guide only invites users to explore Operations [ev-4ac01f128e04], and nothing describes an environment state that the change affects. A text naming the Operation CRD's group, plus any behaviour that affects existing environments, is needed before an exposure condition can be confirmed.
